units.title: Travel / Viajes

grammar.explanation_es: Usamos el present perfect para experiencias y acciones recientes: 'I have visited Paris', 'She has lost her passport'.
examples: I have visited Paris twice.
She has lost her passport.
Have you ever flown abroad?
We have already booked the flight.
They have never been to London.

sentences: I have visited Paris twice.
She has lost her passport.
We have already booked the flight.
Have you ever travelled abroad?

units.title: Health / La salud

grammar.explanation_es: Usamos 'should' para dar consejos: 'You should rest', 'You shouldn't work so much'.
examples: You should rest more.
You shouldn't eat junk food.
She should see a doctor.
We should drink more water.
You should take this medicine.

sentences: You should rest more.
She should see a doctor.
You shouldn't eat junk food.
We should drink more water.

units.title: Opinions / Opiniones

grammar.explanation_es: Conectamos ideas con palabras como 'because', 'however', 'so': 'I think so because it is cheaper'.
examples: In my opinion, reading is important.
I agree with you.
However, it is expensive.
I think it will probably rain.
Actually, I disagree with that.

sentences: In my opinion reading is important.
I agree with you completely.
I think it will probably rain.
However it is too expensive.

units.title: Work & Studies / Trabajo y estudios

grammar.explanation_es: Para acciones que empezaron en el pasado y continúan: 'I have been working here for two years'.
examples: I have been working here for two years.
She has been studying all day.
How long have you been learning English?
They have been looking for a job.
We have been waiting for an hour.

sentences: I have been working here for two years.
She has been studying all day.
They have been looking for a job.
We have been waiting for an hour.

units.title: Technology / Tecnología

grammar.explanation_es: Conectamos información: 'who' para personas, 'which/that' para cosas: 'the app that I use'.
examples: This is the app that I use.
She is the person who helped me.
I bought a phone which has a great camera.
The website that you sent is useful.
He is someone who knows a lot.

sentences: This is the app that I use.
She is the person who helped me.
I need to update my password.
The website that you sent is useful.

units.title: Feelings / Sentimientos

grammar.explanation_es: Tras una preposición usamos verbo + -ing: 'I am afraid of flying', 'tired of waiting'.
examples: I am excited about traveling.
She is tired of waiting.
He is worried about losing his job.
We are happy about winning.
They are scared of failing.

sentences: I am excited about traveling.
She is tired of waiting.
He is worried about the exam.
We are happy about the news.
